title: Orphaned VSDD code catalog: 9 codes cited in 6 live dispatch-injected files with no surviving defining home (W0010, W0030, W0070, W0080, W0180, E0010, E0016, E0018, E0050)

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: P4/#148 (adopter code-catalog integrity) is the CI-grade mechanization of this issue. Answered mdatron on vsdd-cli GH#27 (comment 5155546223), grounded in the live corpus (89 VSDD- citations). SO-ratified governance: comprehensive=true (one authoritative catalog; any unlisted VSDD- token is an orphan that hard-blocks) + severity=error (dangling-reference class). Remediation scope once mdatron ships MDATRON-E0113: author .mdatron/code-catalogs.yaml with the FULL legal VSDD- set (reconstructing the defining home that DESIGN-VERIFICATION.md carried before the #826 cleanup, not just the 9 currently-cited orphans), then declare/fix the orphans red->green. Grammar pinned: VSDD- + one uppercase class letter (E/W in use) + exactly 4 digits.
